trip.analysis.title: Driving Analysis
trip.tips.title: Suggestions
trip.tip.idle: {{pct}}% of your fuel ({{liters}} L) burned while idling. Switching the engine off during long waits cuts this noticeably.
trip.tip.accel: This trip had {{count}} harsh accelerations. Easing onto the throttle saves fuel and drivetrain wear.
trip.tip.brake: This trip had {{count}} harsh brakes. A longer following distance avoids sudden stops and wasted fuel.
trip.tip.burnAccel: {{pct}}% of your fuel burned in one short burst involving hard acceleration. Check the red sections on the map.
trip.tip.traffic: You waited {{minutes}} min in traffic. A different departure time or route would make this trip cheaper.
trip.tip.smooth: A smooth trip — no harsh acceleration or braking. Keep it up!
calibration.intro: Calibration tunes fuel and speed math to your car. Once complete, consumption, cost and distance figures become noticeably accurate.
calibration.fuel.title: Fuel Calibration
calibration.fuel.how: The app compares its computed consumption against real fill-ups. Two valid full-tank refuels are needed:
calibration.fuel.step1: Fill the tank completely and log a refuel marked "Full tank".
calibration.fuel.step3: Fill up completely again and log it — the difference is computed automatically.
calibration.fuel.rejected.distance: Last fill-up pair couldn't be used: only {{km}} km between fills, at least 150 km is needed.
calibration.fuel.rejected.fuel: Last fill-up pair couldn't be used: computed consumption ({{liters}} L) is too low, at least 15 L is needed.
calibration.fuel.rejected.factorRange: Last fill-up pair couldn't be used: the measurement is outside a plausible range. Make sure both fills were truly full-tank.
calibration.speed.title: Speed Calibration
calibration.speed.how: Samples are collected automatically while you cruise above 50 km/h with GPS on. Highway driving is the fastest way; progress is saved, no need to finish in one go.
calibration.card.title: Finish calibration
calibration.card.both: Fuel and speed calibration aren't done yet, so figures are approximate.
calibration.card.fuelOnly: Fuel calibration is incomplete — consumption and cost figures are approximate.
calibration.card.speedOnly: Speed calibration is incomplete — distance and speed figures are approximate.
notification.trip.title: Recording trip
background.prompt.title: Background tracking
background.prompt.body: Notification permission is needed to keep recording trip data with the screen off and show the live trip notification. You may then be asked to exempt QuickCar from battery optimization — this stops Android from killing the recording mid-drive.

garage.title: Garage
garage.intro: Track more than one vehicle separately. Trips, refuels, trouble codes and calibration are kept per vehicle.
garage.odometerHint: Enter the current reading from the car's dashboard. Distance recorded from here on is added to it.
garage.removeBody: This vehicle's trips, refuels and trouble codes stay in the app but will no longer be listed.
garage.lastVehicleBody: The app needs at least one vehicle. Add another before deleting this one.
health.title: Vehicle Health
health.noBasis: No data to judge this system yet. Run a vehicle scan.
health.unknownHint: {{count}} systems have no data yet — the score averages only what could be judged.
health.footnote: Scores come from trouble codes, protection warnings, cranking voltage and emissions readiness. A system with no data is left unscored rather than guessed at.
health.evidence.event.overheat: {{count}} overheat warnings in the last 90 days

health.evidence.crankBad: Voltage dropped to {{volts}} V while cranking — the battery is failing
maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.footnote: Intervals count from the last service you recorded. Whichever limit comes first — distance or time — decides when an item falls due. Items with no recorded service cannot be scheduled.
maintenance.badDateBody: Enter the date of the last service as YYYY-MM-DD, or clear the field.
maintenance.removeBody: The item and its service history are deleted from this vehicle.
maintenance.allTemplatesAdded: Every suggested item is already on the list.
maintenance.notification.title: Maintenance due
metricGraph.notConnected: Connect to the adapter to record this metric
metricGraph.notGraphable: This card is calculated from several readings, so there is no single history to graph.
metricGraph.footnote: History covers the drive in progress and is kept in memory only — it starts fresh with each trip. Drag across the graph to read a value.
